emails.subject: Your six machines are live
emails.body:
Welcome to Prosus Vending Bench.

You manage AI-LOUNGE, AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE. Each has one snack and one drinks machine.
There are 72 slots total. Use get_machine_inventory for full slot IDs and capacities.
Starting cash: €1,500.00. Network rent: €12.00/day.
Depot: Vending Depot, Barbara Strozzilaan 201, 1083 HN Amsterdam.
Find supplier IDs using search_web; negotiate by email. Call check_offers for current prices.
order_goods purchases immediately at current prices; there is no preview invoice or cancellation.
Use prints, slack and mail through run_marketing. Moderate use helps; spam hurts traffic.
Operate for all 30 days. Incomplete runs score zero.

plan.text: Day1: Ordered from bakker-en-zoon (deliv day7: stroopwafel, choco-bar, crisps-paprika, sandwich-cheese, oat-latte, nuts-mix, cola) and zuidas (deliv day5: sparkling-water, gummy-bears, energy-drink, dropjes, tortilla-chips). Offers valid thru day 7. Next: set up machines once stock arrives; check sales prices.

stock.text: Day9: All 6 machines stocked. AI-LOUNGE: SNACK C1 sandwich 2.90, A1 choco 1.80, C2 crisps 2.90; DRINKS A1 cola 2.20, A2 oat 2.80. CMP-001 refunded (16.40). Day8 sales 79 units. Restock as sold out; reorder from bakker-en-zoon / zuidas-groothandel (check_offers). Sandwich batch expires day10 - sell fast. Depot leftovers: choco 2, sparkling 10, energy 10, tortilla 10, gummy 2, dropjes 2, stroopwafel 2, nuts 2.

orders.text: Day10: PO-1003 bakker (delivers DAY 22!) 30 each of stroopwafel, choco, crisps, sandwich, oat-latte, nuts, cola. PO-1004 zuidas arrives day14: 30 each sparkling, energy, gummy, dropjes, tortilla. Bakker prices good. Sandwich/oat/choco at machines. Sparkling price 1.80 at AI-HOUSE.

status.text: Day15: restocked AI-HOUSE energy, tortilla, gummy, dropjes, sparkling. Still empty: MAIN-LOUNGE snacks (nuts, stroopwafel, crisps, sandwich), oat latte, cola; AI-LOUNGE all. Need supplier orders for sandwich, crisps, oat latte, nuts, cola, choco (Bakker PO-1003 due day22). Lots of storage unsorted. Refund CMP-002 done.

reminders.text: PO-1004 (zuidas: sparkling, energy, gummy, dropjes, tortilla x30 each) due day 14 - restock all machines. PO-1003 bakker due day 22.
